name: Pyro-Related Reactions
description:
Vaporize: DMG +100% for this instance, with every 8 Elemental Mastery contributing an additional 100%
Melt: DMG +100% for this instance, with every 8 Elemental Mastery contributing an additional 100%
Overloaded: DMG + 1, the target is switched to the previous character, with the two characters switching places and taking 1 Piercing DMG
Burning: Apply 1 stack of Perpetual Burn to the target
Pyro Crystallize: Create 3 Shield points
Pyro Swirl: DMG +1, deals 1 Pyro DMG to all opposing characters except the target
